newsitem.title: UK: UK Jan net bank mortgage lending rises 771 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: UK Jan net bank mortgage lending rises 771 mln stg.

text.p: Net lending for house purchases by major British banks rose a seasonally adjusted 771 million stg after a 643 million increase in December, the British Bankers' Association said.
Unadjusted gross lending was 2.085 billion stg in January, down around 16 percent from the December figure of 2.476 billion.
The number of new mortgage approvals fell to 31,637 from 32,234 in December while their value fell to 1.798 billion from 1.883 billion.
"The major banks' net mortgage lending strengthened appreciably in January," BBA director-general Tim Sweeney said.
"All told the major banks' mortgage figures for the month provide support for the view that the early months of 1997 will see further sustainable recovery in housing market activity."
